outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no plotted quantification; no averaged data is shown, so the check does not apply.

Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20). No individual data points/dots are overlaid on the bars, so the underlying variability is not visible.
Panel C is a western blot image only (HMGB1 and GAPDH bands); no quantification plot is shown, so the check does not apply.

Panel D includes SDH/COX micrographs plus bar charts of signal intensity across WT, Atxn1-KI, and Atxn1-KI;HMGB1 groups, with sample sizes noted in the bars but only mean and error bars shown — no individual data points are overlaid.

Panel E shows FACS histogram plots (cell counts vs. TMRM intensity distributions) alongside a schematic. These are distribution/line-type plots, which are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
